agents.role: OpenSpec and agent version-governance gap review
agents.result: Baseline exists but lacks executable per-slice version manifest, schema bump rules, fixture/evidence compatibility, and upstream bump invalidation policy.
important_gaps: OpenSpec/spec revision not in L3 evidence

agents.role: Rust crate, toolchain, oracle, fixture, and evidence version source review
agents.result: Crate version and toolchain are known; FlashDB is pinned by commit; schema fields and cache metadata are inconsistent across historical artifacts.
